document.abstract: In stereoradiography, image displacement is obtained either by shifting the x-ray tube, or, less often, by keeping the tube stationary and rotating the subject through a few degrees of angle between exposures. Either of the methods can be applied to stereo cinefluorography, but the rotational method has the advantage of not requiring special x-ray equipment. A single-film projector having two picture apertures for stereo projection of rotational films is described.
